items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Before I went uptown, I heard Clarence Profit and Bobby Henderson play.

ctx.x: I was pretty good on the ukelele. We used to do that. Then when I moved uptown... I have a picture of me when I was there. You should see it. I mean, he brought a couple of pictures.
